description: Bootstrap v3.3.6 JavaScript library source code, including modules for transitions, alerts, buttons, carousels, collapse, dropdowns, and modals.

classes.name: Alert
classes.description: Handles alert dismissals with transition support.

classes.name: Carousel
classes.description: Controls carousel slide transitions, cycling, and indicators.

classes.name: Collapse
classes.description: Handles show/hide of collapsible elements with transition support.

classes.name: Dropdown
classes.description: Manages dropdown menu toggling and keyboard navigation.

classes.name: Modal
classes.description: Controls modal dialog display, hiding, backdrop, and focus management.

classes.name: Tooltip
classes.description: Provides tooltip UI component with positioning and content management.

classes.name: PopOver
classes.description: Provides popover UI component extending tooltip functionality.

classes.name: ScrollSpy
classes.description: Tracks scrolling to update active navigation items.

classes.name: Affix
classes.description: Enables sticky positioning of elements based on scroll position.

classes.name: Affix
classes.description: Handles sticky positioning of elements based on scroll position, with methods for determining state, pinned offset, and position checks.

methods.name: transitionEnd
methods.description: Detects the end event name for CSS transitions.

methods.name: emulateTransitionEnd
methods.description: Simulates transition end after a specified duration.

methods.name: to
methods.description: Navigates carousel to a specific slide index.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Moves carousel to the next slide.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Moves carousel to the previous slide.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Handles escape key to close modal.

methods.name: backdrop
methods.description: Manages modal backdrop display and removal.

methods.name: adjustDialog
methods.description: Adjusts modal dialog size and position.

methods.name: enter
methods.description: Handles mouseenter or focusin for tooltip.

methods.name: isInStateTrue
methods.description: Checks if tooltip is in active state.

methods.name: leave
methods.description: Handles mouseleave or focusout for tooltip.

methods.name: getCalculatedOffset
methods.description: Calculates tooltip offset based on placement.

methods.name: getViewportAdjustedDelta
methods.description: Adjusts tooltip position to stay within viewport.

methods.description: Determines whether the element should be affixed to top, bottom, or not at all based on scroll position and offsets.
